# Third-party notices

Generated by `node scripts/collect-third-party-notices.mjs` using locked, offline Cargo metadata and installed npm sources. No package installation or build is performed. `--refresh-models` explicitly refreshes official model license/terms snapshots; ordinary runs do not contact the network.

Inventory: 685 Cargo packages and 134 npm lock entries. Exact license/notice copies: 1218. Original source-package notice gaps: 130; see `missing-notices.json`.

This conservative all-target/development inventory is **not proof of the components in any installer**. A declared production dependency may be tree-shaken; build/proc-macro and other-platform sources may never ship. Nested vendor/example licenses are preserved without claiming every nested component is distributed. Preserve each package's selected license obligations and exact copyright text. The scanner does not extract source-file-only license headers, infer missing notices, or certify compliance.

`inventory.json` records source package URLs, versions, original license expressions, copied relative paths, file hashes and lockfile hashes. `models/sources.json` records official model snapshot provenance. Existing snapshots are not deleted automatically; use the inventory as the current file list.

Before release, reconcile the actual Windows/macOS artifacts (including C/C++ vendor code, DLLs, WebView2, OpenMP/Vulkan/Metal redistributables, model files and artwork) with this inventory. MPL entries need an actual shipped-source assessment. Gemma 3 needs its separate terms, restrictions and Notice; it must not be labeled Apache-2.0. No publisher identity or application license is inferred by this collector.

## Target-specific reconciliation

The original source gaps are classified in [reconciliation/README.md](reconciliation/README.md) with machine-readable dispositions and exact-commit recovered notices. Use that report to distinguish runtime candidates from build/optional/inactive entries. The number in missing-notices.json is the raw installed-source gap count, not the number of unresolved runtime release obligations.
